verdict.reasons: The candidate successfully displays the correct white-and-blue cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll with readable and authentic branding, and the exact required watermark is present. However, the installed irrigation evidence fails the technical match criteria: the lateral lines visible on the soil are thick, round black hoses rather than thin, flattened drip tapes. This constitutes an incorrect installation geometry that contradicts the requested '20 cm emitter spacing drip-tape laterals' context. While the wrong installed tubing and the product's placement on top of the soil are minor advisory defects rather than total rejections, they prevent the image from reaching the required minimum quality score of 90.

focused_physical_review.reason: A continuous dark irrigation line is visible at the right base of the white-and-blue AFP package, immediately transitioning into a distinct loose, uninstalled coil on the adjacent soil. The required AFP package is not separated from the irrigation line (line_touches_or_crosses_package=true) and a broad uninterrupted soil gap around the package is not visible. The loose coil on the soil represents a distinct additional product outside the required package, constituting an extra_loose_product_coil. No protruding white ribbons, straps, or tape tails are visible emerging from the package.
